transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I came in because... well, I've been having this issue with eating. When I'm alone at night, once I start eating, it just feels like something else takes over. I can't stop. Even when I'm literally telling myself to put the food away, I just keep going. It's really starting to bother me.
After these eating episodes, do you do anything to try to get rid of the food or prevent weight gain, such as making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or fasting?

Yeah, I do. After I eat like that, I usually end up going to the bathroom and making myself throw up. It just... it feels like it's the only way to undo what I just did, you know? Like I have to get it out before the calories actually settle in.
Could you tell me your current height and weight?
I'm about 5 foot 10. As for my weight, um... I'm not exactly sure right this minute. I think I'm somewhere around 170 pounds, maybe a little less. It fluctuates a bit, but that's my best guess.
In a typical week, about how often do these episodes of binge eating and making yourself throw up occur?

Well, I'd say it usually happens at least once a week. It's been going on like this for at least the last four months now. Pretty much every week there's at least one night where I'm home alone, I end up eating way more than I ever intended to, and then... yeah, I make myself throw up right after.
